note: Module registry: which files each module owns, its public interface, dependencies, tests and data. Every application source file belongs to exactly one module (tests/test_modules.py checks this). See docs/MODULAR_ARCHITECTURE.md.

modules.name: Application core
modules.purpose: Server startup, request handling, route composition, background jobs, platform helpers, shared paths.
modules.data: None of its own. Reads the active project folder (BOOK_PROJECT or the install folder).
modules.guidance: Change only for cross-cutting needs. New features add a module listed in routes.FEATURES instead of editing webapp.py's dispatch.

modules.name: Book management
modules.purpose: Multi-book Library, project registry, templates and new projects, book metadata (Book Details), app settings, dashboards and health.
modules.data: Owns book.yml metadata lines (never the chapter list), and app data in BOOK_BUILDER_HOME (registry.json, settings.json).
modules.guidance: book.yml edits must stay line-based and refuse any change to parts. Never invent records: unknown checks are 'unchecked'.

modules.name: Content and chapters
modules.purpose: Outline parsing, chapter files and statuses, drafts, revisions, approvals, research import, glossary and front-matter specials, legacy menu.
modules.data: Owns book/, drafts/, reviews/, research/ (per project). Approved prose is never rewritten by tools.
modules.guidance: Any write to a chapter goes through chapter.py commands; keep approval explicit.

modules.name: AI writing and handoffs
modules.purpose: Prompt packs (copy and ZIP), prompt kinds, ChatGPT Project workspace files and instructions.
modules.data: Writes prompts/ and dist/prompt-packs, dist/chatgpt-project-files; reads research and agents/.
modules.guidance: Prompts must be self-contained; never assume files the AI can't see.

modules.name: Book design
modules.purpose: Book typography and Google Fonts, PDF template colors and fonts, print layout, citation style, Pandoc filters.
modules.data: Per-project brand lives in the project's assets/; app UI colors are NOT part of this module.
modules.guidance: Book brands style book outputs only, never the Book Builder interface.

modules.name: Publication
modules.purpose: PDF/EPUB/DOCX/HTML builds, the reader website (Astro site), GitHub Pages publishing, Save Work (git).
modules.data: Writes dist/ and site/dist (generated, ignored); publishes only approved content.
modules.guidance: Publishing and pushing always need an explicit user action. Save Work commits only the book's folders.

modules.name: Interactive (games)
modules.purpose: Game Package API: import, validation, image sheets, preview, approval, export.
modules.guidance: Never execute imported game code server-side; keep API 1.0 packages working.

modules.name: Web interface
modules.purpose: The browser UI: navigation, pages, existing workflows, icons. Colors are locked (docs/upgrade-audit/baseline.md).
interfaces: builder.js APP_NAV/PROJECT_NAV/PAGES (one place for menus and pages)
modules.data: Browser localStorage for per-viewer conveniences only.
modules.guidance: Do not change :root color tokens. Add a page by adding a PAGES entry and a nav sub-item.

modules.name: Application management
modules.purpose: Install, launch, source revision, ZIP updates, source and book-data backups, QA and QA review ZIPs, diagnostics, AI development handoffs.
modules.data: Owns BOOK_BUILDER_HOME/backups, logs, qa, packages, handoffs, manager-state.json.
modules.guidance: Standard library only. Never weaken stale-revision or hash checks; never let a source operation touch book data.

modules.name: Documentation and tests support
modules.purpose: User and developer documentation, shared test fixtures.
modules.guidance: Keep docs in step with behaviour; don't describe unbuilt features as done.
